description: A picturesque, tree-lined 18-hole course established in Queens Park Gardens in the centre of Invercargill. One of the few golf courses in the heart of a city.

name: Hikurangi Golf Club
description: An inviting 18-hole course set amid the rolling hills of Northland, just north of Whangarei. Picturesque views and well-kept fairways make Hikurangi a pleasant stop for golfers exploring the region.

name: Houhora Golf Club
description: New Zealand's most northerly golf course, situated on State Highway 1 between Kaitaia and Cape Reinga. This welcoming 9-hole layout (playable as 18 with alternate tees) is surrounded by lush greenery and coastal scenery, making it a bucket-list stop for golfing travellers.

name: Ngunguru Golf Club
description: A charming 9-hole course nestled in the Ngunguru Sports Complex on the beautiful Tutukaka Coast. The stunning coastal backdrop and relaxed pace make it a delightful detour for golfers visiting Northland.

name: Whakatane Golf Club
description: A friendly club in the sunny Bay of Plenty town of Whakatane, enjoying one of New Zealand's highest annual sunshine hours. A welcoming course that makes for an enjoyable round in a warm, relaxed coastal setting.

name: Palmerston North Golf Club
description: An affordable public course in Palmerston North, offering accessible golf on a well-maintained parkland layout. The course provides good value for golfers of all levels in the Manawatu region.

name: Wanganui Golf Club
description: An established club with a well-regarded parkland layout in Whanganui, featuring mature trees and thoughtfully designed holes. The course provides a quality round in one of the lower North Island's most characterful river cities.

name: Whangamata Golf Club
description: A links-influenced course near the popular surf beach of Whangamata on the Coromandel Peninsula. Coastal breezes and sandy terrain give the layout a seaside character that sets it apart from the region's inland parkland courses.

name: Waitangi Golf Club
description: A casual and welcoming club near the historic Waitangi Treaty Grounds in the Bay of Islands. Its relaxed vibe and storied surroundings make it a fitting choice for golfers soaking in the cultural and natural beauty of the region.

name: Templeton Golf Club
description: An affordable parkland course west of Christchurch, offering a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere for golfers of all skill levels. The flat, easy-walking layout makes it a good choice for casual rounds.

name: Selwyn Golf Club
description: A growing club in the fast-expanding Selwyn district southwest of Christchurch. The course caters well to the area's increasing population, providing an accessible and enjoyable golfing option on the Canterbury Plains.

name: Timaru Golf Club
description: The main South Canterbury club in Timaru, providing the region's premier golfing experience. Well-established fairways and quality greens make it the first choice for competitive and social golf in the area.

name: Oreti Beach Golf Club
description: A links course near the famous Oreti Beach, where motorcycle legend Burt Munro once set speed records on the sand. The coastal winds and open terrain create a true links test on the outskirts of Invercargill.

name: North Otago Golf Club
description: Well-maintained North Otago club in the Victorian whitestone city.

name: Rangiora Golf Club
description: A popular North Canterbury club in the thriving town of Rangiora, just 30 minutes from Christchurch. The mature parkland setting and well-conditioned course make it a favourite among local and visiting golfers.

name: Wainui Golf Course
description: An affordable, all-abilities course north of Auckland. Its welcoming atmosphere and accessible layout make it a great starting point for new golfers or a relaxed round for visitors.

name: Poverty Bay Golf Club
description: A scenic links-influenced course in Gisborne, the first city in the world to see the sunrise each day. Coastal character and well-maintained fairways make it the premier golfing destination on the East Cape.

name: Cambridge Golf Club
description: An attractive parkland layout in the elegant garden town of Cambridge, one of the Waikato's most charming destinations. Tree-lined fairways and well-kept greens make for a pleasant round in a picturesque setting.

name: Blenheim Golf Club
description: A pleasant parkland course in the heart of Marlborough wine country near Blenheim. The flat, well-maintained layout is ideal for a relaxed round, with vineyards and the Richmond Range providing an attractive backdrop.

name: Havelock North Golf Club
description: A pleasant parkland club in the acclaimed wine village of Havelock North, offering well-maintained fairways surrounded by the rolling hills and vineyards of Hawke's Bay. The welcoming club provides a fine complement to the area's renowned food and wine scene.

name: Papamoa Golf Club
description: A popular public course in the rapidly growing Papamoa suburb of Tauranga. Its accessible layout and sunny Bay of Plenty location make it a great choice for golfers of all levels.

name: Ashburton Golf Club
description: The main Mid-Canterbury club in Ashburton, serving as the hub for golf in the district. The well-maintained parkland layout offers an enjoyable round on the fertile Canterbury Plains, with views toward the Southern Alps.

name: Papatoetoe Golf Club
description: An affordable South Auckland club that caters to recreational golfers of all levels. Its convenient suburban location and relaxed pace make it an easy choice for a casual round.

name: Thames Golf Club
description: A scenic course in Thames, the gateway to the Coromandel Peninsula. Its convenient location makes it an ideal first or last round for golfers heading to or from the Coromandel's coastal courses.

name: Kaiapoi Golf Club
description: A riverside parkland course in Kaiapoi, set along the banks of the Kaiapoi River just north of Christchurch. The water features and mature trees create an attractive and enjoyable golfing environment.

name: Te Awamutu Golf Club
description: A well-regarded club in the rural Waikato town of Te Awamutu, known as the former home course of professional golfer Andrew Whiley. Consistent conditions and a welcoming atmosphere make it a solid choice for visitors to the region.

name: Lincoln Golf Club
description: A pleasant course in the university town of Lincoln, south of Christchurch. The rural Canterbury setting and friendly atmosphere make it a relaxed spot for a round among the farming and academic community.

name: Waikanae Golf Club
description: A pleasant parkland course near Waikanae Beach on the Kapiti Coast, offering tree-lined fairways and well-maintained greens. The gentle layout and coastal climate make it an enjoyable round for golfers of all abilities.

name: Cromwell Golf Club
description: A visitor-friendly club surrounded by the mountains and orchards of the Cromwell Basin in Central Otago. The dramatic landscape and dry climate make it a reliable year-round golfing destination.

name: Mercury Bay Golf & Country Club
description: Scenic holiday course in Mercury Bay on the Coromandel Peninsula.

name: Gisborne Park Golf Club
description: The main parkland course in Gisborne, set in the first city in the world to greet each new day's sun. A well-maintained layout offering an enjoyable round in a region rich with Maori culture and stunning coastal scenery.

name: Alexandra Golf Club
description: A parkland course set in the fruit-growing heartland of Alexandra, where Central Otago's hot summers and golden autumns create ideal playing conditions. The layout is well suited to visitors touring the region's vineyards and cycle trails.

name: Kaikoura Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course in Kaikoura where dramatic mountain views meet the Pacific Ocean. The unique coastal mountain setting, with the snow-capped Seaward Kaikoura Range as a backdrop, makes this one of New Zealand's most photogenic golfing locations.

name: Masterton Golf Club
description: The main Wairarapa club, featuring a well-kept parkland layout in the heart of Masterton. Mature trees and gently rolling fairways provide a pleasant test of golf, while the club's welcoming atmosphere makes it a fine base for exploring the wider region.

name: Picton Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course near the Marlborough Sounds ferry terminal in Picton. Its convenient location makes it an ideal round for golfers arriving or departing on the Interislander, with views across the harbour and surrounding hills.

name: Chamberlain Park Golf Course
description: A public parkland course in central Auckland beside Western Springs park. Its accessible inner-city location and open layout make it one of the most convenient places to play in the Auckland region.

name: Aorangi Golf Club
description: A second Timaru course offering affordable golf in South Canterbury. The friendly atmosphere and accessible layout make it a welcoming option for golfers of all abilities.

name: Greenacres Golf Club
description: An affordable parkland course in the Richmond suburb of Nelson, offering accessible golf in one of the country's warmest and driest regions. The well-kept layout provides a pleasant round with mountain views and the relaxed pace of the Nelson lifestyle.

name: Greymouth Golf Club
description: The main West Coast golf club, situated in Greymouth with well-maintained parkland fairways. It provides the best golfing experience on the Grey district coastline, with lush green conditions thanks to the region's generous rainfall.

name: Matamata Golf Club
description: A parkland course set in the rolling green farmland of Matamata, famous worldwide as the home of Hobbiton. Great value rural golf in one of the Waikato's most picturesque settings.

name: Te Puke Golf Club
description: An affordable club in Te Puke, the kiwifruit capital of New Zealand. A pleasant rural course surrounded by the orchards and green farmland of the western Bay of Plenty.

name: Kapiti Coast Golf Club
description: An affordable public course on the Kapiti Coast, providing accessible golf in a relaxed setting. The coastal climate ensures year-round playability, making it a popular choice for local and visiting golfers.

name: Motueka Golf Club
description: A welcoming parkland course near Abel Tasman National Park, offering a pleasant round in one of New Zealand's sunniest regions. The lush surroundings and relaxed atmosphere make it a great stop for golfers exploring the Nelson Tasman area.

name: 90 Mile Beach Golf Links
description: A quirky 9-hole links at the southern end of iconic Ninety Mile Beach, where sheep share the fairways and the Tasman Sea provides the backdrop. It is one of the most unusual and memorable golfing experiences in New Zealand.

name: Feilding Golf Club
description: A welcoming rural club in the garden town of Feilding, known for its well-kept grounds and friendly atmosphere. The parkland layout offers an enjoyable round with views across the rich Manawatu farmland.

name: Levin Golf Club
description: An affordable parkland course in Levin, featuring flat, well-maintained fairways that suit golfers of all levels. The accessible layout and welcoming club provide good-value golf in the Horowhenua district.

name: Kaikohe Golf Club
description: An affordable rural parkland course in the Far North town of Kaikohe. Its easygoing atmosphere and gentle terrain make it a pleasant option for a casual round while exploring the mid-North.

name: Tokoroa Golf Club
description: An affordable parkland course in Tokoroa, surrounded by the forests and farmland of the central Waikato. A friendly club offering good value golf in a peaceful rural setting.

name: Riverton Golf Club
description: A links-influenced coastal course near the historic port town of Riverton, one of New Zealand's oldest European settlements. Sea breezes and estuary views add character to this enjoyable Southland layout.

name: Methven Golf Club
description: A rural course near the ski village of Methven, offering spectacular views of the Southern Alps including Mt Hutt. The mountain scenery and crisp Canterbury air enhance every round at this welcoming country club.

name: Hokitika Golf Club
description: A links-style coastal course in the jade carving town of Hokitika on the West Coast. The seaside setting and ever-changing weather conditions create a memorable round, with views stretching to the Southern Alps on a clear day.

name: Carterton Golf Club
description: A championship parkland course in the Wairarapa town of Carterton, with well-maintained fairways and challenging holes at an affordable price. The tree-lined layout provides a solid test of golf surrounded by the rolling farmland of the Wairarapa.

name: Waitara Golf Club
description: A rural parkland course near the Taranaki coast, where Mt Taranaki provides a spectacular backdrop to your round. The welcoming club and well-kept fairways offer an enjoyable experience for visiting golfers.

name: Gore Golf Club
description: The main club in Eastern Southland, serving the town of Gore and the surrounding farming district. A well-presented course that provides a reliable round for visitors passing through the region.

name: Inglewood Golf Club
description: An affordable parkland course in Inglewood with stunning views of the Mt Taranaki volcano dominating the skyline. The well-maintained layout and dramatic volcanic backdrop make every round a visual treat.

name: Twizel Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course near Lake Pukaki and Aoraki/Mount Cook in the Mackenzie Country. The turquoise glacial lake and towering peaks create one of the most dramatic backdrops in New Zealand golf.

name: Dargaville Golf Club
description: A classic rural club in the kauri country of Northland, close to Dargaville and the Waipoua Forest. The unpretentious layout and friendly locals offer a genuine taste of small-town New Zealand golf.

name: Hawera Golf Club
description: A friendly rural club in the south Taranaki town of Hawera, offering a relaxed atmosphere and well-maintained course. The club's welcoming nature makes it a popular stop for golfers touring the Taranaki region.

name: Geraldine Golf Club
description: A pleasant rural parkland course in the charming garden village of Geraldine in South Canterbury. The well-kept layout and friendly atmosphere make it a lovely stop for golfers exploring the region between Christchurch and the Mackenzie Country.

name: Balclutha Golf Club
description: The main club in South Otago, serving the town of Balclutha and the wider Clutha district. A straightforward, well-kept course that provides a solid round for travellers heading south.

name: Te Anau Golf Club
description: A scenic parkland course in Te Anau, the gateway to Fiordland National Park and Milford Sound. Mountain views frame virtually every hole, making it a rewarding round before or after exploring one of the world's great wilderness areas.

name: Bluff Golf Club
description: The southernmost golf club on the New Zealand mainland, set on exposed links terrain near the famous oyster port of Bluff. Foveaux Strait winds and views toward Stewart Island make every round a memorable southern adventure.

name: Winton Golf Club
description: A rural parkland course in the Southland farming town of Winton. The straightforward layout offers a pleasant, no-fuss round in the heart of the Southland plains.

name: Dannevirke Golf Club
description: An affordable rural club in Dannevirke offering a relaxed round in the southern Hawke's Bay countryside. The course suits golfers of all levels and provides good value in a friendly, no-fuss setting.

name: Westport Golf Club
description: An affordable and welcoming West Coast club in Westport, set against a dramatic backdrop of bush-clad hills and rugged coastline. The well-maintained course offers an enjoyable round for visitors exploring the Buller region.

name: Tekapo Golf Club
description: A stunning 9-hole beside the turquoise waters of Lake Tekapo, framed by the Southern Alps. The extraordinary natural setting, with its unique glacial lake colour and mountain panorama, makes this one of the most visually spectacular courses in the country.

name: Wairoa Golf Club
description: A rural club in the small town of Wairoa, offering very affordable golf between Gisborne and Napier. A relaxed, no-frills course ideal for golfers passing through the northern Hawke's Bay region.

name: Foxton Golf Club
description: A links-influenced coastal course near Foxton Beach, where sea breezes and sandy soil create fast-running conditions reminiscent of traditional links golf. The course offers good value and year-round playability on the Manawatu coast.

name: Naseby Golf Club
description: A historic course in the former gold-field village of Naseby, perched at 600 metres above sea level on the Maniototo Plain. The crisp high-country air and unique sub-alpine setting make it one of the more memorable 9-hole experiences in Otago.

name: Waipukurau Golf Club
description: A rural parkland course in the heart of Central Hawke's Bay, providing a pleasant test of golf with tree-lined fairways and well-maintained greens. The relaxed country atmosphere and affordable play make it a popular choice for locals and visitors to the Waipukurau area.

name: Kawerau Golf Club
description: A budget-friendly rural club in Kawerau, set against the dramatic backdrop of the Tarawera Ranges. A good-value round in a region known for its geothermal activity and native forests.

name: Marton Golf Club
description: A rural parkland club in the Rangitikei town of Marton, offering well-kept fairways and a friendly country atmosphere. The course provides honest, good-value golf amid the rolling farmland of the central North Island.

name: Stratford Golf Club
description: A budget-friendly parkland course in the Taranaki town of Stratford, offering accessible golf beneath the towering presence of Mt Taranaki. The no-frills layout provides honest country golf at excellent value.

name: Raglan Golf Club
description: A compact 9-hole course near the famous surf beach of Raglan on the Waikato's rugged west coast. A fun, laid-back round that pairs perfectly with a day at one of New Zealand's most iconic coastal towns.

name: Tarras Golf Club
description: An authentic rural club where sheep share the fairways and green fees go into an honesty box. Tarras sits on the main route between Wanaka and Cromwell, offering a quintessentially New Zealand golfing detour.

name: Parahaki Golf Club
description: A compact 9-hole course on the slopes of Parahaki hill in Whangarei. Very affordable and perfect for a quick round, it provides pleasant views across the city and surrounding hills.

name: Mahia Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole links on the beautiful Mahia Peninsula, where dramatic coastal scenery and ocean breezes create a memorable round. The isolated setting on the eastern tip of Hawke's Bay rewards golfers willing to make the journey with stunning views and a true links experience.

name: Waverley Golf Club
description: A quintessential rural New Zealand course where sheep graze the fairways alongside golfers. The pastoral setting in the Waverley farming district provides a uniquely authentic experience you won't find on any manicured championship layout.

name: Opunake Golf Club
description: A scenic 9-hole links on the dramatic south Taranaki coast near Opunake, where ocean views and coastal breezes add character to every hole. The rugged seaside setting along Surf Highway 45 makes for a memorable round.

name: Ranfurly Golf Club
description: A rural Maniototo course in the small town of Ranfurly, known for its art deco architecture. The flat, open layout and big Central Otago skies make it a fitting stop for cyclists on the nearby Otago Central Rail Trail.

name: Maramarua Golf Club
description: A budget-friendly rural 9-hole club in the Waikato countryside, offering a relaxed and unpretentious golfing experience. A good option for golfers seeking an affordable round between Auckland and Hamilton.

name: Stewart Island Golf Club
description: One of the southernmost golf courses in the world, located on remote Stewart Island where native kiwi birds may wander the fairways at dusk. The wild, untamed setting makes it a bucket-list experience for adventurous golfers.

name: Martinborough Golf Club
description: A charming 9-hole course in the heart of the renowned Martinborough wine village, perfect for combining a round with a cellar door visit. The relaxed country atmosphere and compact layout make it an ideal stop on a Wairarapa wine trail.

name: Opotiki Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole course at the eastern gateway to the Bay of Plenty, offering a quiet and uncrowded golfing experience. An affordable option for golfers exploring the East Cape region.

name: Taihape Golf Club
description: A characterful rural course in Taihape, self-proclaimed gumboot capital of the world. The course offers rolling terrain and a warm community atmosphere in the rugged hill country between the Rangitikei River and the Ruahine Range.

name: Wakefield Golf Club
description: A friendly rural 9-hole near the historic town of Wakefield in the Tasman region. The peaceful countryside setting and well-maintained layout provide an enjoyable round for golfers of all abilities.

name: Kaka Point Golf Club
description: A remote coastal 9-hole near the wildlife-rich Catlins region, where penguins and sea lions are never far away. The rugged southern coastline provides a dramatic backdrop for a casual seaside round.

name: Rakaia Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole near the famous Rakaia River, renowned for its salmon fishing. The flat Canterbury Plains setting and quiet country atmosphere make it a pleasant and unpretentious golfing experience.

name: Amberley Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole in scenic North Canterbury near Amberley, offering a peaceful country golfing experience. The rolling terrain and views of the surrounding hills provide an attractive setting for a relaxed round.

name: Franz Josef Golf Club
description: A budget-friendly 9-hole near the famous Franz Josef Glacier, offering golfers a unique opportunity to play surrounded by rainforest and mountain scenery. The compact course is a fun diversion for travellers exploring Glacier Country.

name: Waimarino Golf Club
description: Championship course at 580m elevation in the heart of the Central Plateau.

name: Reefton Golf Club
description: A tiny rural course in the historic gold-mining town of Reefton on the West Coast. The tranquil bush setting and quirky country charm make it a memorable stop for golfers venturing off the beaten track.

name: Roxburgh Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole course in the Clutha Valley near the town of Roxburgh, surrounded by stone-fruit orchards and rolling farmland. It provides a quiet, unhurried round in one of Central Otago's most picturesque river valleys.

name: Kingston Golf Club
description: A tiny 9-hole at the southern tip of Lake Wakatipu, surrounded by tussock-covered mountains. The stunning alpine lake views and peaceful isolation make it a worthwhile detour on the road between Queenstown and Te Anau.

name: Manapouri Golf Club
description: An extraordinary 9-hole beside the crystal-clear waters of Lake Manapouri, widely regarded as one of New Zealand's most beautiful lakes. The towering Fiordland mountains rising beyond the fairways create a setting that few courses anywhere in the world can match.

name: Renwick Golf Club
description: A small, friendly rural course in the wine village of Renwick, surrounded by Marlborough vineyards. The relaxed atmosphere and easy-walking layout make it perfect for a casual round between cellar door visits.

name: Pleasant Point Golf Club
description: A charming rural 9-hole in the friendly South Canterbury village of Pleasant Point. The relaxed, unpretentious atmosphere and tidy layout make it an enjoyable round for golfers exploring the countryside between Timaru and the Mackenzie Basin.

name: Lumsden Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole in the small town of Lumsden at the gateway to Fiordland. The surrounding farmland and mountain views provide a tranquil backdrop for a casual round.

name: Bulls Golf Club
description: A budget-friendly 9-hole course in the small Rangitikei town of Bulls, offering a relaxed round on a simple rural layout. The no-frills atmosphere and affordable play make it an ideal quick stop for golfers passing through.

name: Dunstan Golf Club
description: Compact 9-hole in the historic gold-rush town of Clyde.

name: Takaka Golf Club
description: A remote rural course in Golden Bay, offering a genuine backcountry golfing experience surrounded by lush farmland and mountain scenery. The relaxed pace and stunning setting make it a worthwhile detour for golfers exploring the top of the South Island.

name: Fairlie Golf Club
description: A rural 9-hole at the gateway to the Mackenzie Basin, with views of the surrounding high-country hills. The small-town charm and spectacular scenery make it a delightful stop for golfers heading into the Mackenzie Country.

name: Tolaga Bay Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole course on the East Cape, offering a genuine off-the-beaten-track golfing experience. One for adventurous golfers exploring the spectacular and uncrowded coastal scenery of State Highway 35.

name: Palmerston Golf Club
description: A small rural 9-hole in the North Otago town of Palmerston, offering a friendly community atmosphere. The course is a convenient stop for travellers on State Highway 1 between Dunedin and Oamaru.

name: Wyndham Golf Club
description: A small rural 9-hole in the Eastern Southland farming community of Wyndham. The authentic country atmosphere and modest layout offer a genuine taste of small-town New Zealand golf.

name: Mossburn Golf Club
description: A remote rural 9-hole in the small Southland town of Mossburn, situated at the foot of the Takitimu Mountains on the road to Te Anau. The peaceful farming landscape and mountain views make it a charming detour for travelling golfers.

name: Havelock Golf Club
description: A tiny rural 9-hole in Havelock, known as the mussel capital of New Zealand. The intimate course sits in a scenic setting at the gateway to the Marlborough Sounds, offering a charming and unhurried golfing experience.

name: Duntroon Golf Club
description: A remote 9-hole in the Waitaki Valley near the Vanished World fossil trail and striking limestone formations. The rugged North Otago landscape lends the course a distinctive, almost otherworldly character.

name: Karamea Golf Club
description: A very remote 9-hole near Kahurangi National Park at the northern tip of the West Coast. The isolated location, surrounded by pristine bush and rugged coastline, makes for one of New Zealand's most unique golfing adventures.

name: Ruatoria Golf Club
description: A very remote rural course deep on the East Cape, one of New Zealand's most affordable places to play. An authentic backcountry experience for golfers seeking something truly different on the Pacific Coast Highway.

name: Haast Golf Club
description: Possibly New Zealand's most isolated course, this extraordinarily remote 9-hole sits near Haast Pass where rainforest meets the Southern Alps. Playing here is a true wilderness experience, perfect for golfers seeking something completely off the grid.
